_doc: Shadow report for trust-boundary risk escalation. NOTHING IS GATED BY THIS FILE. It answers one question: over recent history, how often did a merge land in a class the reference would have escalated? The threshold below was pre-registered in the roadmap before this was first read.
decision: JUSTIFIED — 11 of 99 first-parent merges touched a trust-boundary path, at or above the pre-registered threshold of 5. A non-declinable escalation for that class gets its own ADR and its own PR; it is deliberately NOT enabled by this report.
note: Classification is path-based and reproducible from the diff alone — no model judgement. Docs-only changes are exempt by extension, except on kernel-rule paths, where a markdown file IS the governed surface.
